class StringModifier:
    def __init__(self, s):
        self.s = s

    def find_and_replace(self, substring, replacement):
        index = self.s[1: -1].find(substring)
        while index != -1:
            self.s = self.s[: index] + replacement + self.s[index + len(substring): ]
            index = self.s[1: -1].find(substring)

    def print_modified_string(self):
        print self.s
